section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study, consisting of 247 Black female adolescents from the southeastern U.S. The sample included students from a predominantly White institution (n=38) and two Historically Black Colleges and Universities (n=209). Key demographic data provided are a mean age of 17.8 years and a mean BMI of 25.4 kg/m2.
section_summary.evidence_source: Two hundred forty-seven Black female adolescents admitted to either a state-funded predominantly White institution (PWI; n = 38) or one of two Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs; n = 209) located in the southeastern U.S. participated in this study. The mean age of the sample was 17.8 years (SD = 0.47). On average, participants' mothers attained 14.1 years (SD = 2.1) of education. The sample's mean BMI was 25.4 kg/m2 (SD = 6.4). The BMI distribution for the sample was as follows: 6.5% underweight, 51% normal weight, 20% overweight, and 22.4% obese.
